judge.rationale: The candidate correctly implements `accumulateUsage` and wires it into `chatOrchestrator.ts` with solid test coverage for multi-round summation, missing round reports, and budget-closing rounds. However, it misses the acceptance criterion requiring the hook signature/type to make aggregation unambiguous (`OrchestratorHooks.afterModelResponse` still declares `usage?: UsageMetadata` instead of `totalUsage?: UsageMetadata`). In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, it leaves the new `afterModelResponse` behavior under the `Measured semantics — out of scope` heading rather than promoting it to the main specification. Finally, it leaves behind an obsolete intermediate note under `CHANGELOG.md` (`Added`), splits tests and helpers across several new files instead of extending `chatOrchestrator.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and includes extraneous `.lore/dod.md` and `scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs` changes.
